sentences.text: No: for a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges when the sanctioned amount/limit is up to ₹50 lakh, and this case is within that bracket.
The older RBI pre-payment-charge directions are no longer in force on the as-of date, so they do not govern this case.
